desc:
Step into the cage in Realistic Ragdoll MMA, a physics-based fighting game where every hit can turn the fight around. Throw punches, land powerful kicks, toss your opponent and launch flying knees as you fight for victory.

Time your attacks and make every hit count. With physics-driven combat and ragdoll reactions, every fight brings unpredictable moments.

🥊 Punches, kicks, throws and flying knees
💥 Physics-based combat with dynamic ragdoll reactions
🎮 PC, controller and mobile support

Enter the cage. Land the perfect hit. Take the win.
